decision_question: Does the extension support source distribution for direct and staffing-agency application status reconciliation?
acceptance_criteria: Preserve direct application and owner-closeout behavior.
Distinguish and substantiate each milestone and application route.
Require trusted source attribution and destination-specific authorization before status corrections.
Check public-safe fixtures, portable package structure, and exact readback rules.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Separate read-only agent contexts inherited the same model family and worked from the same public-safe source package. The author integrated the findings.
The reviewers did not execute an application workflow or access candidate systems.
Independent roles assessed the staffing-agency changes before final conflict integration. The integration owner performed the final additive merge review and structural checks.

sources.use: Existing canonical package and six direct application case contracts.
Agency-to-client handoff with unknown send time, mirrored correspondence, and an unmatched direct tracker row. No original records are distributed.
Skill Foundry and Equilibrium Review requirements for the source release.
Preserve upstream source coverage recovery, timed event handling, guarded writes, audience controls, and all twelve existing case contracts.
Preserve portfolio sweep coverage, exact route disposition, idempotent event writes, pending retries and all five portfolio cases.
Preserve exact-route source conflict handling, candidate-attributed evidence, timestamp and offset rules, and all five added case contracts.

claim_ledger.claim: Agency receipt, client handoff, client receipt and applicant interview require distinct evidence.
claim_ledger.consequence: False application advancement or wrong destination.

claim_ledger.claim: A relay can corroborate an event only after source authentication and route matching. A trusted event ID is a deduplication key.
claim_ledger.consequence: Spoofed or duplicated evidence can corrupt status.

claim_ledger.claim: A local stage change is verified after reading back the exact authorized row.
claim_ledger.consequence: False synchronization or duplicate effects after retry.

claim_ledger.claim: A newer tracker stage survives a stale conditional write, and a surface without a write guard remains unmodified.
claim_ledger.consequence: Overwritten interview stage and a false synchronization claim.

initial_reviews.finding: The relay fallback conflated observation and delivery dates. The receipt conflict fixture supplied only a sending assertion.
Usable procedure with gaps in positive tracker and independent receipt cases.
Unverified relay identity could be mistaken for authentic provenance. Applicant matching, archive authorization and safe locators needed sharper rules.

decisive_evidence: Trusted-source attribution was missing before event deduplication.
Authored, transport and observation dates require distinct fields.
Handoff and receipt are separate claims. Only same-claim conflicts hold that claim's delta.

revised_reviews.finding: The milestone and date rules now match the evidence. All six baseline case contracts remain intact.
Exact authorized agency tracker mapping and independently confirmed receipt now have a positive case. A true receipt conflict leaves handoff independently updateable.
Trusted provenance precedes deduplication. Applicant identity, destination permission and safe locator rules are explicit.

checks: Ruby YAML parsed name, description, version and metadata.
Validated portable structure, relative links, 30 synthetic case contracts across two files, all 22 upstream contracts preserved, public-safe text and exact release digests.

The Skillz catalog validator reported the same 39-character name against its 36-character catalog cap for baseline and candidate. The portable format allows 64 characters. Retained the existing AskJamie path.

limitations: Reviewed source distribution only. No live agent execution, task quality, uplift, unseen holdout, or host installation is evidenced.

follow_up.condition: Before a live performance or host acceptance claim
follow_up.action: Freeze the exact package and host configuration. Run at least three matched sessions per configuration and a separately authored unseen holdout with blinded grading. Any authorization, identity, privacy or false verification failure blocks the claim.

disruptor.authority: counterexample testing after revised reviews converged
falsification_hypotheses: A matched stage update races with a newer authorized interview update.
A trusted delivery envelope is mistaken for recruiter authorship of user-controlled text.
An application instance is confused with a later attempt on the same requisition and route.
test_results: The unconditional-write draft failed the race thought experiment. The final procedure explicitly requires an atomic write condition or verified exclusive access, rereads on a failed condition, and stages a no-guard delta without mutating.
The final source requires the full claim-bearing relay to be tied to the original author and exact application. A forged ID or quoted body remains a discovery lead.
The final source binds each claim to the applicant and exact application instance and holds ambiguous writes.

decisive_evidence: The material race is addressed in the guarded-write procedure and a new stale-revision fixture.
The final package integrates on PR #147 and preserves its source-coverage and partial access rules.
Independent rechecks identified and resolved the remaining single-source privacy gap. The primary procedure now excludes token-bearing locators regardless of reference loading.
The positive agency case states Saved to Submitted with exact client receipt and both readbacks. Two inherited fixtures explicitly receive trusted-full-relay defaults.

The integration owner reapplied reviewed staffing-agency changes to PR #154 after it merged. Source inspection and exact fixture and evidence comparisons preserve the independently landed behavior and records.
PR #148 landed during CI. Reapplied the reviewed staffing-agency changes and verified its extra identity, conflict, attribution, timing, and outreach boundaries, fixtures and review evidence.
unresolved_items: Live execution and host acceptance remain unevaluated.
